scanNote:
3-UNITNING UCHINCHI BETI (20-bet).

Yuqorida chapda binafsha-ko'k yorliqda oq '3' va yonida 'Shop till you Drop!'

CHAP USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Grammar: Adjectives' sarlavhasi.
• Och yashil ramkali katta quti: 'Order of Adjectives' sarlavhasi bilan. Uch band; misollar to'q sariq QIYA harflarda. Ichida 'Fact Adjectives' jadvali: size, weight, shape, colour, material qatorlari. Eng pastda to'q sariq qiya namuna: 'It's a beautiful, long, light blue, silk skirt.'
11) 'Read the article in Ex. 6 and find three fact adjectives and three opinion adjectives.'
12) 'Number the adjectives in the correct order.' To'rtta gap; sifatlar QALIN harflarda va har birining yonida qavs. 1-gapda raqamlar ALLAQAChON qo'yilgan (2, 3, 1) va o'ngda ko'k qiya javob: 'a beautiful brown wooden box with ...'
13) 'Describe the objects, as in the example.' Ko'k qiya namuna: "It's a grey plastic suitcase with stickers on it." Ostida SURATLI jadval: chamadon (stickers), uzuk (diamonds), soyabon (handle), sayohat sumkasi (strap, zip, side pocket), to'p (spots), tuflilar (laces), kepka (peak), ruchka (top). Har bir qismga ko'k strelka bilan yorliq qo'yilgan.

O'NG USTUN:
14) a) 'Match the shapes (a - d) to the adjectives.' Qiya harflarda: triangular ..., round ..., rectangular ..., square ... Ostida to'rtta ko'k shakl: a - kvadrat, b - to'rtburchak, c - uchburchak, d - doira.
   b) 'Find the objects that match descriptions 1 - 3, then describe the other objects.' Ostida och ko'k fonli SURAT: portfel (briefcase), kiyim ilgichi (coat hanger), disk (CD), ryukzak (rucksack), budilnik (alarm clock), tennis to'pi (ball), hamyon (wallet), fotoapparat (camera), muzlatgich (fridge). Har biriga yorliq yozilgan.
Ostida uchta tavsif va nuqtali joy.
15) 'GAME: Write short descriptions of objects. Read them aloud and let the class guess what objects you are describing.'
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Communication: Describing Lost Property' sarlavhasi.
16) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'Listen and repeat. Then, in pairs, use the prompts to act out similar dialogues.' A va B dialogi; ba'zi so'zlar tagiga chizilgan. Ostida qiya harflarda uchta ko'rsatma: wallet, suitcase, rucksack.
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Writing (Project)': 'Read the letter in the Photo File section and say which object is described. Then, choose one of the other objects and write a letter to the lost property office.'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '20'.

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI.


1) SIFAT OTNI TASVIRLAYDI:

  'Adjectives describe nouns. They have
   the same form in the singular and
   plural.'

  e.g. a blue dress - two blue dresses

  ⚠ ENG MUHIM FARQ: ingliz sifati
  KO'PLIKDA O'ZGARMAYDI.
  ⚠ 'two blueS dresses' - XATO.


2) IKKI TUR SIFAT:

  OPINION (fikr) adjectives:
     beautiful, great, expensive, nice
     = biz NIMA DEB O'YLAYMIZ

  FACT (haqiqat) adjectives:
     short, long, red, wooden
     = narsa ASLIDA QANDAY

  ⚠ QOIDA: OPINION sifati FACT
  sifatidan OLDIN turadi.

  'She's wearing a BEAUTIFUL RED dress.'
     (opinion) (fact)

  ⚠ 'a red beautiful dress' - XATO.


3) FACT SIFATLARINING TARTIBI:

  size     - small, big, short, long
  weight   - heavy, light
  shape    - triangular, round,
             rectangular, square
  colour   - dark/light blue, yellow,
             pink, cream, red, purple
  material - cotton, leather, silk,
             plastic, woollen, nylon,
             metal, gold, silver, velvet,
             wooden, canvas

  ⚠ KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  "It's a beautiful, long, light blue,
   silk skirt."
     beautiful - OPINION
     long      - SIZE
     light blue - COLOUR
     silk      - MATERIAL


⚠ QISQA ESLATMA (yodlash uchun):

  FIKR → O'LChAM → OG'IRLIK →
  ShAKL → RANG → MATERIAL → OT

  ⚠ O'zbekchada bunday qat'iy tartib
  yo'q - shuning uchun bu qoidani
  ataylab yodlash kerak.


⚠ VERGUL QO'YILADIMI:

  Kitobdagi namunada vergul bor:
  'a beautiful, long, light blue, silk
   skirt'
  ⚠ Vergulsiz ham to'g'ri:
  'a beautiful long light blue silk
   skirt'
  ⚠ Amalda 2-3 tadan ortiq sifat kam
  ishlatiladi.


⚠ MATERIAL SIFATLARI - OTDAN:

  gold, silver, metal, plastic, silk,
  cotton, velvet, canvas - bular OT,
  lekin sifat vazifasida ishlatiladi.

  ⚠ Ba'zilari -EN oladi:
     wood → wooden
     wool → woollen
     gold → golden (ko'chma ma'noda)

  ⚠ 'a gold ring' = oltindan uzuk
  ⚠ 'a golden opportunity' = oltin
     imkoniyat (ko'chma)

points.en: Adjectives describe nouns. They have the same form in the singular and plural. e.g. a blue dress - two blue dresses
points.uz: Sifatlar otni tasvirlaydi. Ular birlikda va ko'plikda bir xil shaklda bo'ladi. Masalan: ko'k ko'ylak - ikkita ko'k ko'ylak
points.noteUz:
⚠ Ingliz sifati KO'PLIKDA O'ZGARMAYDI.
⚠ 'two blueS dresses' - XATO.

⚠ Bu - o'zbek tilidan farq qiladigan muhim joy.

points.en: Opinion adjectives (beautiful, great, expensive) describe what we think of someone or something.
points.uz: Fikr sifatlari (chiroyli, zo'r, qimmat) biz kimdir yoki nimadir haqida nima deb o'ylashimizni bildiradi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Bular SUBYEKTIV - har kim boshqacha o'ylashi
mumkin.

points.en: Fact adjectives (short, long, red) describe what someone or something really is.
points.uz: Haqiqat sifatlari (kalta, uzun, qizil) narsaning aslida qandayligini bildiradi.
points.noteUz: ⚠ Bular OBYEKTIV - o'lchash yoki ko'rish mumkin.

points.en: Opinion adjectives go before fact adjectives. She's wearing a beautiful red dress.
points.uz: Fikr sifatlari haqiqat sifatlaridan oldin turadi. U chiroyli qizil ko'ylak kiygan.
points.noteUz:
⚠ ASOSIY QOIDA.
⚠ 'a red beautiful dress' - XATO.

points.en: size: small, big, short, long, etc
points.uz: o'lcham: kichik, katta, kalta, uzun va h.k.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Fact sifatlari tartibida BIRINChI.
⚠ 'etc' = 'et cetera' = va hokazo.

⚠ 'light' IKKI ma'noda: yengil va och (rang).
⚠ 'light blue' = och ko'k.

points.en: shape: triangular, round, rectangular, square, etc
points.uz: shakl: uchburchak, dumaloq, to'rtburchak, kvadrat va h.k.

points.en: colour: dark/light blue, yellow, pink, cream, red, purple, etc
points.uz: rang: to'q/och ko'k, sariq, pushti, krem, qizil, binafsha va h.k.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'dark' va 'light' rang oldida turadi va
BIRGA bitta sifat hisoblanadi.

points.en: material: cotton, leather, silk, plastic, woollen, nylon, metal, gold, silver, velvet, wooden, canvas, etc
points.uz: material: paxta, charm, ipak, plastik, jun, neylon, metall, oltin, kumush, baxmal, yog'och, brezent va h.k.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Otdan yasalgan sifatlar - OTGA ENG YaQIN
turadi.
⚠ 'wood' → 'wooden'; 'wool' → 'woollen'.

points.en: It's a beautiful, long, light blue, silk skirt.
points.uz: Bu chiroyli, uzun, och ko'k ipak yubka.
points.noteUz:
⚠ KITOBDAGI NAMUNA - to'rt sifat to'g'ri
tartibda:
  beautiful (opinion) → long (size) →
  light blue (colour) → silk (material)

exercises.instructionEn: Read the article in Ex. 6 and find three fact adjectives and three opinion adjectives.
exercises.instructionUz: 6-mashqdagi maqolani o'qing va uchta haqiqat sifati hamda uchta fikr sifatini toping.
exercises.explanationUz:
19-BETDAGI MAQOLADAN.


FACT ADJECTIVES (haqiqat) - misollar:

  large (department stores) - o'lcham
  small (antique shops)    - o'lcham
  little (streets)         - o'lcham
  woollen (skirts)         - material
  leather (jackets)        - material
  big (bank accounts)      - o'lcham

  ⚠ Bularni O'LChASh yoki KO'RISh
  mumkin.


OPINION ADJECTIVES (fikr) - misollar:

  delightful (smaller shops)
  fantastic (furniture)
  great (department stores / variety)
  rare (books)
  trendiest (boutiques)
  fashionable (clothes)

  ⚠ Bular bir odamga to'g'ri, boshqasiga
  noto'g'ri tuyulishi mumkin.


⚠ 'HIGH QUALITY' - QAYSI TUR:

  'high quality woollen skirts'
  ⚠ 'high quality' bu yerda OT+OT
  birikmasi bo'lib, sifat vazifasida.
  Uni ham FIKR sifatiga yaqin deb
  hisoblash mumkin.


⚠ 'RARE' - CHEGARADAGI SO'Z:

  'a rare book' - kitobning kam
  uchrashi HAQIQAT, lekin 'noyob'
  deyish BAHO ham beradi.

  ⚠ Bunday chegaradagi so'zlar bor -
  muhimi, tartibni to'g'ri qo'yish.

points.noteUz:
⚠ 'woollen' va 'leather' - MATERIAL sifatlari.
⚠ Material sifati OTGA ENG YaQIN turadi.

⚠ 'delightful' - BAHO beradi: kimgadir yoqimli,
kimgadir yo'q.

points.en: OPINION: the trendiest boutiques, fashionable clothes
points.uz: FIKR: eng modabop butiklar, modabop kiyimlar

exercises.instructionEn: Number the adjectives in the correct order.
exercises.explanationUz:
TARTIB: FIKR → O'LChAM → OG'IRLIK →
ShAKL → RANG → MATERIAL


HAR BANDNING TAHLILI:

  1  brown (rang) = 2
     wooden (material) = 3
     beautiful (fikr) = 1
     → 'a BEAUTIFUL BROWN WOODEN box
        with a brass lock'
     ⚠ Kitobda BERILGAN (namuna).

  2  cotton (material) = 3
     large (o'lcham) = 1
     grey (rang) = 2
     → 'a LARGE GREY COTTON shirt with
        a white collar'

  3  heavy (og'irlik) = 1
     metal (material) = 3
     black (rang) = 2
     → 'a HEAVY BLACK METAL saucepan
        with brown handles'

  4  silk (material) = 3
     blue (rang) = 2
     nice (fikr) = 1
     → 'a NICE BLUE SILK scarf with
        yellow stars on it'


⚠ HAR BANDDA MATERIAL OXIRIDA:

  wooden, cotton, metal, silk -
  hammasi OTGA ENG YaQIN turadi.

  ⚠ Bu - eng oson eslab qolinadigan
  qoida: MATERIAL HAR DOIM OXIRIDA.


⚠ 'WITH' BILAN QO'ShIMChA TAFSILOT:

  '... with a brass lock'
  '... with a white collar'
  '... with brown handles'
  '... with yellow stars on it'

  ⚠ Sifatlar OTDAN OLDIN, qo'shimcha
  tafsilot esa 'with' bilan OTDAN
  KEYIN.


⚠ YANGI SO'ZLAR:

  brass    = jez, latun
  a lock   = qulf
  a collar = yoqa
  a saucepan = kastryulka
  a handle = dasta
  a scarf  = ro'mol, sharf

exercises.instructionEn: Describe the objects, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  "It's a grey plastic suitcase with
   stickers on it."

  ⚠ Qolip: It's a + SIFATLAR + OT +
     with + QO'ShIMChA TAFSILOT.


SURATDAGI BUYUMLAR VA QISMLARI:

  a suitcase - stickers (yorliqlar)
  a ring - diamonds (olmoslar)
  an umbrella - a handle (dasta)
  a travel bag - a strap (tasma),
     a zip (zamok), a side pocket
     (yon cho'ntak)
  a ball - spots (dog'lar)
  shoes - laces (bog'ichlar)
  a cap - a peak (kozirok)
  a pen - a top (qopqoq)


⚠ 'WITH ... ON IT':

  'with stickers ON IT' = ustida
  yorliqlari bor.

  ⚠ 'on it' - buyum ustidagi narsa
  uchun. Ichidagi narsa uchun 'in it'.


⚠ 'A ZIP' va 'A ZIPPER':

  Britaniyada 'a zip', AQShda
  'a zipper'.


⚠ 'SHOES' - HAR DOIM JUFTLIKDA:

  'a pair of shoes' = bir juft tufli.
  ⚠ 'laces' ham ko'plikda.


⚠ 'A PEAK':

  = kepkaning kozirogi; cho'qqi.
  ⚠ 'peak' va 'pick' talaffuzi boshqa:
  peak /piːk/ (uzun), pick /pɪk/ (qisqa).

exercises.instructionEn: Match the shapes (a - d) to the adjectives.
exercises.explanationUz:
SHAKL SIFATLARI.

  a - KVADRAT (to'rt teng tomon)
  b - TO'RTBURChAK (uzun, cho'ziq)
  c - UChBURChAK
  d - DOIRA


⚠ OT VA SIFAT JUFTLIKLARI:

  a square    → square
     (ot va sifat BIR XIL)
  a rectangle → rectangular
  a triangle  → triangular
  a circle    → round / circular

  ⚠ 'round' - oddiy nutqda;
  'circular' - rasmiy/texnik.


⚠ YANA ShAKLLAR:

  oval      - oval
  a diamond - romb
  a star    - yulduz
  a heart   - yurak
  a cube    - kub
  a sphere  - shar
  a cylinder - silindr


⚠ 'SQUARE' - KO'P MA'NOLI:

  1) kvadrat (shakl)
  2) maydon: 'Trafalgar Square'
  3) kvadrat (matematikada):
     'four squared' = to'rtning kvadrati


⚠ 'A TRIANGLE':

  'tri-' (uch) + 'angle' (burchak)
  = uch burchakli shakl.

  ⚠ 'tri-' old qo'shimchasi: tricycle
  (uch g'ildirakli velosiped),
  triple (uch karra).

pairs.whyUz:
⚠ a - KVADRAT (to'rt teng tomon).
⚠ 'square' - OT va SIFAT bir xil shaklda.

exercises.instructionEn: Find the objects that match descriptions 1 - 3, then describe the other objects.
exercises.instructionUz: 1 - 3 tavsiflarga mos buyumlarni toping, so'ng qolgan buyumlarni tasvirlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
SURATDAGI BUYUMLAR:

  a briefcase   - portfel
  a coat hanger - kiyim ilgichi
  a CD          - disk
  a rucksack    - ryukzak
  an alarm clock - budilnik
  a ball        - to'p
  a wallet      - hamyon
  a camera      - fotoapparat
  a fridge      - muzlatgich


TAVSIFLARNING TUZILIShI - TO'RT QISM:

  1) O'LChAM + ShAKL + RANG:
     'It's a small triangular brown
      object.'
  2) MATERIAL:
     "It's made of wood and metal."
  3) VAZIFA:
     'We hang clothes on it.'

  ⚠ Bu - buyumni nomini bilmasdan
  tasvirlashning universal usuli.
  Chet tilda so'z esdan chiqsa, aynan
  shunday tushuntiriladi.


⚠ 'TO BE MADE OF' va 'TO BE MADE FROM':

  made OF - material KO'RINIB turadi
     'made of wood', 'made of leather'
  made FROM - material O'ZGARGAN
     'Paper is made from wood.'

  ⚠ Tavsiflarda 'made OF'.


⚠ 'AN OBJECT':

  = buyum, narsa.
  ⚠ Urg'u: OBject (ot) - obJECT (fe'l,
  'e'tiroz bildirmoq').


⚠ QOLGAN BUYUMLARNI TASVIRLASh:

  briefcase: 'It's a large rectangular
     black object. It's made of leather.
     We carry papers in it.'
  CD: 'It's a small round silver object.
     It's made of plastic. We listen to
     music on it.'
  rucksack: 'It's a large orange object.
     It's made of nylon. We carry things
     in it on our back.'
  alarm clock: 'It's a small square white
     object. It's made of plastic. It
     wakes us up.'
  camera: 'It's a small black object.
     It's made of plastic and metal. We
     take photos with it.'
  fridge: 'It's a big rectangular white
     object. It's made of metal. We keep
     food cold in it.'

pairs.left: 1  It's a small triangular brown object. It's made of wood and metal. We hang clothes on it.
pairs.leftUz: Bu kichkina uchburchak jigarrang buyum. Yog'och va metalldan. Unga kiyim ilamiz.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'triangular' - ilgichning shakli uchburchakka
o'xshaydi.
⚠ 'to hang' = ilmoq (hang - hung - hung).
⚠ 'a coat hanger' - qo'shma ot.

pairs.left: 2  It's a small round yellow object. It's made of wool and rubber. We play tennis with it.
pairs.leftUz: Bu kichkina dumaloq sariq buyum. Jun va kauchukdan. U bilan tennis o'ynaymiz.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'rubber' = kauchuk, rezina.
⚠ 'play tennis' - artiklsiz.
⚠ Tennis to'pi ustidan jun bilan qoplangan.

pairs.left: 3  It's a small rectangular black object. It's made of leather. We keep our money in it.
pairs.leftUz: Bu kichkina to'rtburchak qora buyum. Charmdan. Unda pulimizni saqlaymiz.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'a wallet' - erkaklar hamyoni (qog'oz pul
uchun).
⚠ 'a purse' - Britaniyada ayollar hamyoni;
AQShda ayollar sumkasi.
⚠ 'to keep' = saqlamoq.

pairs.left: It's a large rectangular black object. It's made of leather. We carry papers in it.
pairs.leftUz: Bu katta to'rtburchak qora buyum. Charmdan. Unda hujjat olib yuramiz.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'a briefcase' = portfel ('brief' - hujjat +
'case' - quti).
⚠ 16-mashqdagi dialogda ham bor.

pairs.left: It's a small round silver object. It's made of plastic. We listen to music on it.
pairs.leftUz: Bu kichkina dumaloq kumushrang buyum. Plastikdan. Unda musiqa tinglaymiz.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'a CD' = 'a compact disc'.
⚠ 'listen TO music' - predlog ShART.

pairs.left: It's a big rectangular white object. It's made of metal. We keep food cold in it.
pairs.leftUz: Bu katta to'rtburchak oq buyum. Metalldan. Unda ovqatni sovuq saqlaymiz.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'a fridge' = 'a refrigerator' ning qisqasi.
⚠ 'to keep sth cold' = sovuq saqlamoq.

exercises.instructionEn: GAME: Write short descriptions of objects. Read them aloud and let the class guess what objects you are describing.
exercises.instructionUz: O'YIN: Buyumlarning qisqa tavsifini yozing. Ovoz chiqarib o'qing va sinf qaysi buyumni tasvirlayotganingizni topsin.
exercises.explanationUz:
TASVIRLASh O'YINI.

  ⚠ 14b mashqidagi UCh QISMLI qolipdan
  foydalaning:

  1) O'LChAM + ShAKL + RANG
     "It's a small round white object."
  2) MATERIAL
     "It's made of plastic."
  3) VAZIFA
     'We tell the time with it.'


⚠ NIMA UChUN BU O'YIN MUHIM:

  Chet tilda gapirganda so'z esdan
  chiqishi TABIIY hol. Muhimi -
  to'xtab qolmaslik, balki so'zni
  TUShUNTIRIB berish.

  ⚠ Bu ko'nikma 'paraphrasing' deb
  ataladi va real muloqotda eng
  foydali ko'nikmalardan biri.


⚠ FOYDALI QOLIPLAR:

  "It's a kind of ..."
     = bu bir turdagi ...
  'It's something you use for ...ing.'
     = bu ... qilish uchun ishlatiladigan
       narsa
  "It's the opposite of ..."
     = bu ... ning aksi
  "It's similar to ..."
     = bu ... ga o'xshaydi

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and repeat. Then, in pairs, use the prompts to act out similar dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va takrorlang. So'ng juftlikda ko'rsatmalar bilan shunga o'xshash dialoglarni ijro eting.
exercises.explanationUz:
YO'QOLGAN BUYUM HAQIDA DIALOG.

  ⚠ Bu - haqiqiy hayotda kerak bo'ladigan
  vaziyat: vokzal, aeroport, mehmonxona.


DIALOGNING TUZILIShI - BESh QADAM:

  1) MUAMMONI AYTISh
     "Excuse me. I've lost my briefcase.
      Has anybody handed it in?"

  2) TAVSIF SO'RASh
     'What does it look like?'

  3) TASVIRLASh
     "It's a black leather briefcase with
      a brown handle."

  4) IChIDAGISINI SO'RASh
     "What's it got in it?"

  5) TOPILISh
     'Is this it?' - 'Oh, yes! Thank you
      very much!'


⚠ 'TO HAND STH IN':

  = topilgan narsani topshirmoq.
  ⚠ 'Has anybody handed it in?' =
  kimdir topshirdimi?

  ⚠ Zarrachali fe'l: to'ldiruvchi
  o'rtada bo'lishi mumkin:
  'handed IT in'.


⚠ "WHAT DOES IT LOOK LIKE?":

  = u qanday ko'rinadi?
  ⚠ 6-betda ODAM haqida edi, bu yerda
  BUYUM haqida - qolip BIR XIL.


⚠ "WHAT'S IT GOT IN IT?":

  = ichida nima bor?
  ⚠ To'liq: 'What has it got in it?'
  ⚠ Britaniya so'zlashuv uslubi.


⚠ 'LOST PROPERTY':

  = yo'qolgan buyumlar.
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN: 'lost properties'
  XATO.
  ⚠ 'the Lost Property Office' -
  vokzallardagi topilma buyumlar bo'limi.
  ⚠ AQShda 'Lost and Found'.


⚠ 'A PURSE' - IKKI MA'NO:

  Britaniyada: ayollar hamyoni
  AQShda: ayollar sumkasi

  ⚠ Dialogda Britaniya ma'nosida.


KO'RSATMALAR (yangi dialog uchun):

  wallet: money, photos, driving licence,
     phonecard
  suitcase: clothes, shoes, camera,
     a bottle of perfume
  rucksack: notebooks, wallet, identity
     card, four books

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Excuse me. I've lost my briefcase. Has anybody handed it in?
lines.uz: Kechirasiz. Portfelimni yo'qotib qo'ydim. Kimdir topshirdimi?
lines.whyUz:
⚠ "I've lost" - PRESENT PERFECT: yo'qotdim va
hozir ham topilmagan.
⚠ 'to hand sth in' = topilgan narsani topshirmoq.

lines.speaker: B
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 6-betdagi ODAM haqidagi savol bilan BIR XIL
qolip - bu yerda buyum haqida.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: It's a black leather briefcase with a brown handle.
lines.uz: Bu jigarrang dastali qora charm portfel.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ SIFATLAR TARTIBI: black (rang) → leather
(material) → briefcase.
⚠ Qo'shimcha tafsilot 'with' bilan OTDAN KEYIN.

lines.speaker: B
lines.whyUz:
⚠ To'liq shakli: 'What has it got in it?'
⚠ Britaniya so'zlashuv uslubi.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: My purse, some credit cards and my passport.
lines.uz: Hamyonim, bir nechta kredit karta va pasportim.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Where and when did you lose it?
lines.whyUz:
⚠ PAST SIMPLE - aniq vaqtda bo'lgan ish.
⚠ 'did' dan keyin fe'l ODDIY shaklda: 'lose'.

lines.speaker: B
lines.whyUz:
⚠ Juda qisqa, lekin to'liq gap: 'this' - ega,
'it' - to'ldiruvchi.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Oh, yes! Thank you very much!

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, use the prompts to act out similar dialogues.

exercises.explanationUz:
UCh YANGI DIALOG.

  ⚠ Har ko'rsatmada BUYUM va uning
  IChIDAGI narsalar berilgan.
  Tavsifni (rang, material) O'ZINGIZ
  o'ylab topasiz.


⚠ 'A DRIVING LICENCE':

  = haydovchilik guvohnomasi.
  ⚠ Britaniyada 'licenCe' (ot),
  'licenSe' (fe'l).
  ⚠ AQShda ikkalasi ham 'license'.


⚠ 'AN IDENTITY CARD':

  = shaxsni tasdiqlovchi hujjat.
  ⚠ Qisqartmasi: 'an ID card' yoki
  'an ID' /ˌaɪˈdiː/.


⚠ 'A PHONECARD':

  = telefon kartasi (taksofon uchun).
  ⚠ Kitob 2000-yilda yozilgan - o'sha
  paytda keng ishlatilgan.

Namuna: "I've lost my wallet. It's a small brown

It's got clothes, shoes, a camera and a bottle
of perfume in it."

⚠ 'a bottle of perfume' - 18-betda ham bor edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the letter in the Photo File section and say which object is described. Then, choose one of the other objects and write a letter to the lost property office.
exercises.instructionUz: Photo File bo'limidagi xatni o'qing va qaysi buyum tasvirlanganini ayting. So'ng boshqa buyumlardan birini tanlang va yo'qolgan buyumlar bo'limiga xat yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
YO'QOLGAN BUYUM HAQIDA XAT.

  ⚠ Bu - RASMIY xat, shuning uchun
  qisqartma IShLATILMAYDI:
     'I have lost' ('I've lost' emas)
     'I would be grateful'
     ('I'd be grateful' emas)


RASMIY XATNING TUZILIShI:

  1) Murojaat: 'Dear Sir/Madam,'
     ⚠ Kimga yozayotganingizni bilmasangiz.

  2) SABAB: nima yo'qoldi, qayerda,
     qachon
     'I am writing to report the loss
      of my ...'

  3) TAVSIF: rang, material, o'lcham,
     ichidagisi
     'It is a ... with ...'

  4) ILTIMOS:
     'I would be grateful if you could
      contact me ...'

  5) Yakun: 'Yours faithfully,'
     ⚠ 'Dear Sir/Madam' bilan boshlansa
     'Yours faithfully'.
     ⚠ Ism bilan boshlansa ('Dear Mr
     Brown') - 'Yours sincerely'.


⚠ RASMIY VA NORASMIY XAT FARQI:

  NORASMIY (9-betdagi Susanning xati):
     Dear Mum and Dad, ... Love, Susan
     qisqartma BOR

  RASMIY (bu xat):
     Dear Sir/Madam, ...
     Yours faithfully, ...
     qisqartma YO'Q


⚠ 'THE LOST PROPERTY OFFICE':

  = topilma buyumlar bo'limi.
  ⚠ Britaniya vokzallari va
  aeroportlarida bo'ladi.
  ⚠ AQShda 'Lost and Found'.

structure.noteUz:
⚠ Kimga yozayotganingizni bilmasangiz shunday
yoziladi.
⚠ Keyin VERGUL.

structure.modelEn: I am writing to report the loss of my rucksack. I lost it at Victoria Station on Monday evening.
structure.modelUz: Ryukzagimning yo'qolgani haqida xabar berish uchun yozyapman. Uni dushanba kuni kechqurun Viktoriya vokzalida yo'qotdim.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ RASMIY xatda qisqartma YO'Q: 'I am'
("I'm" emas).
⚠ 'to report the loss of sth' - rasmiy ibora.

structure.modelEn: It is a large orange nylon rucksack with a black strap and two side pockets.
structure.modelUz: Bu qora tasmali va ikkita yon cho'ntakli katta to'q sariq neylon ryukzak.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ SIFATLAR TARTIBI: large (o'lcham) → orange
(rang) → nylon (material).
⚠ Qo'shimcha tafsilot 'with' bilan.

structure.modelEn: It has got some notebooks, my wallet, my identity card and four books in it.
structure.modelUz: Ichida bir nechta daftar, hamyonim, shaxsiy guvohnomam va to'rtta kitob bor.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ 'has got ... in it' - 16-mashqdagi
"What's it got in it?" savoliga javob.

structure.modelEn: I would be grateful if you could contact me on 020 7946 0123 if anybody hands it in.
structure.modelUz: Agar kimdir topshirsa, 020 7946 0123 raqamiga bog'lansangiz minnatdor bo'lardim.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ 'I would be grateful if you could ...' -
rasmiy iltimos qolipi.
⚠ 'to hand sth in' - 16-mashqda ham bor edi.
⚠ 'contact me ON [raqam]' - predlog 'on'.

⚠ 'Dear Sir/Madam' bilan boshlansa -
'Yours faithfully'.
⚠ Ism bilan boshlansa - 'Yours sincerely'.

sentencePatterns.introUz: Buyumni tasvirlash va yo'qolgan narsani so'rash.

patterns.exampleEn: It's a beautiful, long, light blue, silk skirt.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu chiroyli, uzun, och ko'k ipak yubka.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ TARTIB: FIKR → O'LChAM → OG'IRLIK → ShAKL →
RANG → MATERIAL → OT.
⚠ MATERIAL HAR DOIM OXIRIDA.

patterns.exampleEn: It's a grey plastic suitcase with stickers on it.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu ustida yorliqlari bor kulrang plastik chamadon.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Sifatlar OTDAN OLDIN, qo'shimcha tafsilot
'with' bilan OTDAN KEYIN.

patterns.formula: It's made of [material]. We [fe'l] with it / in it / on it.
patterns.exampleEn: It's made of leather. We keep our money in it.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'made OF' - material ko'rinib turadi.
⚠ Buyum nomini bilmasangiz - shu qolip bilan
tushuntiring.

patterns.formula: I've lost my [narsa]. Has anybody handed it in?
patterns.exampleEn: I've lost my briefcase. Has anybody handed it in?
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ PRESENT PERFECT - hozir ham topilmagan.
⚠ 'to hand sth in' = topilgan narsani topshirmoq.

patterns.exampleUz: U qanday ko'rinadi? - Bu qora charm portfel.
